title: Ta to na
description: The tongue-curl row ట ఠ డ ఢ ణ and the soft dental row త థ ద ధ న.

items.gloss: Ta — hard t, tongue curled back

words.gloss: Ta — hard t, tongue curled back (retroflex)

items.note: Retroflex ట vs dental త is THE Telugu t-contrast: టమాటా has the hard one, తల (head) the soft one.

items.gloss: Tha — hard t with a puff of breath

words.gloss: Tha — ట with a puff of breath

items.note: ఠ is a circle with a bar inside — don't mistake it for the open bowl of ట.

items.gloss: Da — hard d, tongue curled back

words.gloss: Da — hard d, tongue curled back

items.note: డబ్బు (money) — a word you already haggle with. డ and ఢ differ only by ఢ's little tail.

items.gloss: Dha — hard d with a puff of breath

words.gloss: Dha — డ with a puff of breath

items.gloss: Na — n with the tongue curled back

words.gloss: Na — retroflex n, tongue curled back

items.note: ణ never begins a word — you'll always meet it later in the word, as in బాణం (arrow) or వీణ (veena).

items.gloss: ta — soft t, tongue at the teeth

words.gloss: ta — soft t, tongue at the teeth (dental)

items.gloss: tha — soft t with a puff of breath

words.gloss: tha — త with a puff of breath

items.note: థ rarely starts a word; look for it inside words like రథం — the temple chariot.

items.gloss: da — soft d, tongue at the teeth

words.gloss: da — soft d, tongue at the teeth

items.gloss: dha — soft d with a puff of breath

words.gloss: dha — ద with a puff of breath

items.note: ధ is ద wearing a check-mark on top — the mark is the puff of air.

words.gloss: na — everyday n, as in నేను (I)

items.note: న opens నేను, నాన్న, నీళ్ళు — half the words you already speak. The other n, ణ, is the curled one.
